items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: the two guys that really sounded to me like Art, was Willie Hawkins and it was another guy in Cleveland, from Cleveland rather. Lanny Scott. Did I mention Lanny, that I saw him playing with Jonah's band in Boston this past season, with Cozy Cole and John Brown playing bass. But

ctx.x: Al McKibbons from Detroit, and I met another very fine drummer at that time, Kelly Martin. He was a drummer with Errol in later years. Very fine drummer. But

I want to say Willie Hawkins, these are the two guys that really sounded to me like Art, was Willie Hawkins and it was another guy in Cleveland, from Cleveland rather. Lanny Scott. Did I mention Lanny, that I saw him playing with Jonah's band in Boston this past season, with Cozy Cole and John Brown playing bass. But I just heard that Lanny just died also. But he was one of the few guys that really sounded like Art. You know, well he's from Cleveland too, and Art was just his idol.
So I think that about wraps it up.
